raw:
The paper builds an agentic LLM pipeline for screening and classifying literature. RAG appears only as one of the categories of papers being classified. The abstract does not say the pipeline retrieves documents at inference time and conditions generation on them. It uses a keyword search to gather records, and the agents then screen and interpret abstracts. That is closer to LLM-based classification than to RAG. Because the registered definition requires retrieved text to be given to the generator, E1 (not about RAG) fits best.

{"decision":"EXCLUDE","code":"E1","reason":"Agentic LLM screening pipeline; RAG is only a classified topic, not the method."}
